propositions: set_project and remove_project accept invalid project keys (syntactically malformed strings like "le-g", "", "1x", or keys with trailing whitespace) without validation, allowing them to be written to projects.json and failing later in reconciliation
Invalid keys should be rejected at write time by reusing the existing fetcher._validate_project_key function before the record is persisted, raising a clear error and leaving projects.json unchanged
Valid project keys matching the pattern ^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]*$ (e.g. "REB", "PROJ_2") must continue to be accepted and written correctly
Invalid-key ValueError from set_project/remove_project must be mapped to RebarError(returncode=2) at the _lib_ops seam so CLI and MCP write tools surface a clean non-zero error with no traceback
